entries.positive_observation: The yellow compact mascot has green-ringed solid black eyes, exactly one broad slightly open smile, no human skin, nose or ears, distinct dark brows, short dark temple/sideburn hair and a clean-shaven chin without glasses or facial hair. The dark gray-green peaked cap retains two principal silver front-insignia groups, silver braid/piping and a glossy dark visor with a pale reflection. The dark military jacket retains its pale, light-outlined patterned collar details without visible count duplication. The nearly frontal slight-left pose, friendly smile, soft light and visor shadow remain recognizable. The rounded chin sits close to a short broad fitted collar without pinching, floating cloth, a long neck or cream bib. The complete dark photographic backplate and thin frame remain. The cream note retains two compact upper mark rows and blank lower paper; the added independent lower dash is absent and the small compact dark right-edge tab is restored. Full white/cyan/alpha comparisons show no visible interior hole, lost backing or working-matte halo.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the unchanged native RGBA with actual source alpha extrema [0,255] and returned alpha extrema [0,254]. Full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha review shows genuine transparency outside the complete frame/note silhouette, opaque-looking photographic backing, clothing and note, and no visible interior holes or matte halo. Internal near-opacity values 252-254 are retained as measured and do not block approval under visible-alpha-v1. No source-alpha replacement was performed or is needed.
entries.visible_limitations: At 65x67 the exact motifs inside the tiny cap and collar insignia and the individual note glyph strokes are unreadable. Their visible principal groups, counts and positions were checked without claiming microscopic heraldry or writing fidelity; those evidence limits are not rejection grounds.
